text: Good morning.
You're awake.
You're here.
You pressed play.
That's all you need to reach for.
Set the phone down,
and let the screen go dark.
Before you check anything,
give yourself these next few minutes.
The world is still quiet.
You get to start from here.
Let your eyes close.
Take a slow, deep breath in through your nose.
And let it out, nice and easy.
Everything outside this moment can wait.
Now, feel your body.
The warmth under the covers.
The weight of your limbs.
The pulse in your hands.
Wiggle your fingers.
Wiggle your toes.
Bring your attention to the center of your chest.
There's a warmth there.
Small and steady,
like an ember that's been glowing all night.
With each breath in, feel it grow.
Breathing in warmth.
Breathing out ease.
Now, say these words to yourself, gently.
I begin this day warm, and steady.
I meet this day with an open heart.
I have everything this day needs.
Rest here for a moment.
Glowing, quietly, before the world wakes up.
Now picture your morning.
See yourself moving through it with this warmth at your center.
The messages will still be there.
You get to arrive first.
Whatever today brings, this glow is yours.
One slow breath brings you right back.
Take one more deep breath in, gathering all that light.
And let it out,
feeling it settle into every part of you.
When you're ready, let your eyes open.
The day is ready for you.
And you're ready for it.
